claims.text: Argo CD compares the manifests at the Application's target revision with the live objects; sync status is Synced when they match and OutOfSync when any object differs or is missing.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: Core Concepts (Sync status, Live state, Target state); examples/don-hang @ stage-3 outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/gitops-first-sync.txt

claims.text: A sync applies the manifests at the target revision to the cluster, in the manner of kubectl apply, so the live objects match Git.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: Core Concepts (Sync); User Guide > Sync Options (Argo CD executes kubectl apply by default)

claims.text: Argo CD starts syncs by itself only when the Application's sync policy says so (spec.syncPolicy.automated); staging-manual.yaml has no syncPolicy at all, so it reports OutOfSync and waits until someone starts a sync.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: User Guide > Automated Sync Policy; examples/don-hang @ stage-3 deploy/gitops/lessons/staging-manual.yaml

claims.text: Health status is assessed separately from sync status; values include Healthy, Progressing, Missing. A Deployment is Progressing while its new Pods are not yet available and Healthy once they are.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: Operator Manual > Resource Health (Deployment); outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/gitops-first-sync.txt (Progressing at 0/2, Healthy at 2/2)

claims.text: An Application's health is the worst health among the objects it manages, so if any object reports a health worse than Healthy, such as Progressing, the Application reports it too.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: Operator Manual > Resource Health ('The App health will be the worst health of its immediate child sources')

claims.text: Health Missing is reported for objects in Git that do not exist in the cluster yet; before the first sync the Application staging is OutOfSync, Missing.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: Resource Health (Missing); examples/don-hang @ stage-3 outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/gitops-first-sync.txt:3

claims.text: Argo CD looks at manifests in the Application's path and live objects with its tracking annotation (argocd.argoproj.io/tracking-id), written when a sync applies them; a tracked object whose manifest was removed is still listed. Namespace donhang (created by OpenTofu) has neither: untouched.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: User Guide > Resource Tracking; Sync Options (prune); examples/don-hang @ stage-3 scripts/devops/gitops-first-sync.sh:51-55, outputs/.../gitops-first-sync.txt (last line 'no')

claims.text: Argo CD rereads the repository on an interval (not at once); setting the annotation argocd.argoproj.io/refresh=normal on an Application asks it to compare now. The lesson states no interval value.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: FAQ (how often Argo CD checks for changes); User Guide > Annotations and Labels (argocd.argoproj.io/refresh); scripts/lib/gitops.sh app_refresh

claims.text: Writing an operation with sync.revision into an Application via kubectl patch makes Argo CD run a sync without the argocd CLI; initiatedBy only records who asked; the result is reported in .status.operationState.phase (Succeeded in the script's run).
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: User Guide > Sync Applications with Kubectl; examples/don-hang @ stage-3 scripts/devops/gitops-first-sync.sh:31-38, output line 'sync: Succeeded'

claims.text: gitops-first-sync.sh@stage-3 output: OutOfSync/Missing with every resource OutOfSync; after the sync 'sync: Succeeded', staging Synced Progressing with api 0/2 ready; then Synced Healthy with api 2/2; namespace check prints no.
Argo CD does not call the api's /health/ready itself; its Deployment health reads the Deployment's status (updated/available replicas), which depends on Pods passing the readiness probe.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: Resource Health (Deployment); Kubernetes docs: Deployment status, readiness probes; envs/staging/api.yaml:54-64

claims.text: The api's readiness endpoint /health/ready fails when the api cannot reach PostgreSQL, so such an api never becomes ready and the Application stays Synced but not Healthy.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-3 src/DonHang.Api/Program.cs (health checks with the ready tag); lesson k8s.l1.readiness-probes summary line 3

claims.text: Output lines 1-2 come from script lines 15-16 (apply staging-manual.yaml). app_refresh and app_wait come from scripts/lib/gitops.sh (sourced at gitops-first-sync.sh:6); app_refresh annotates the Application; app_wait's 3rd argument is a revision (empty = any commit), the 4th a limit in seconds.

On a first run the script prints OutOfSync/Missing, sync: Succeeded, Synced/Progressing with api 0/2, Synced/Healthy with 2/2, then no. If staging is already Synced and Healthy, it stops after about 120 s with 'staging is still Synced, Healthy after 120 s'.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-3 scripts/lib/gitops.sh app_wait (failure message, return 1); gitops-first-sync.sh:4 (set -euo pipefail), :22; outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/gitops-first-sync.txt
